title: Mapwise amplitude bounds supply the global bounded-below class
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring. Suppose that for every morphism f : X $\to$ Y of schemes [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties] admitting a compactification there is an integer N such that, for every integer m and every L in the ordinary étale derived category [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], L in $D^{\le m}$ implies Rf_! L in $D^{\le m+N}$. Then every such f has a chosen exceptional right adjoint preserving globally bounded-below objects, as bundled by HasBoundedBelowUpperShrieks. This is conditional on the mapwise amplitude bounds; it is not an automatic instance for finite coefficients.

proof.text: For each compactifiable f, eliminate the given existence of an integer N and its upper-amplitude property. Apply lem-etale-upper-shriek-bounded-below-from-amplitude with f, Λ, N and that property; fill the mapwise field of HasBoundedBelowUpperShrieks. This chooses only a proof of a proposition, not functor data.

lean.statement:
theorem hasBoundedBelowUpperShrieks_of_amplitude (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ]
    (h : ∀ {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [HasCompactification f],
      ∃ N : ℤ, ∀ (L : DerivedCategory (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)))
        (n : ℤ), DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.IsLE L n →
          DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.IsLE ((R(f)_![ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).obj L) (n + N)) :
    HasBoundedBelowUpperShrieks (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) ∧
      ∀ {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [HasCompactification f],
        HasBoundedBelowUpperShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f
